description:
Ask for missing information that materially changes the target, scope, or result. Resolve answers available from context or focused investigation first; ordinary implementation choices can follow project conventions. Reuse prior answers and authorization.

Ask 1–4 related questions in one form. Give each a concise header and up to 4 real choices with short labels. Set multiSelect=true only when several choices may apply together. Custom input is provided separately by default: do not add an Other option. The user can review and revise all answers before submitting the form once. Use an empty options array for a text-only question.

questions.description: Related questions to collect in one submission. Stable question IDs are assigned automatically.

question.description: The complete question, explaining what information is needed and why.

header.description: Short label identifying this question in the form navigation.

options.description: Up to 4 actual choices. Do not include a custom-input placeholder; use an empty array for free text.

multiSelect.description: Whether multiple choices and custom input may be combined. Defaults to false.

allowCustom.description: Allow a separate custom answer. Defaults to true; must remain true for text-only questions.
